32045.a:
| Fayl | Ubuntu/Debian | RHEL/Rocky | Nima |
|---|---|---|---|
| Umumiy | `/var/log/syslog` | `/var/log/messages` | servislar, kernel |
| Auth | `/var/log/auth.log` | `/var/log/secure` | ssh login, sudo |
| Kernel | `/var/log/kern.log` | messages | driver, OOM |
| Boot | `/var/log/boot.log` | `/var/log/boot.log` | |
| Paketlar | `/var/log/apt/history.log`, `dpkg.log` | `/var/log/dnf.log` | nima qachon o'rnatildi |
| Login tarixi | `/var/log/wtmp` (`last`), `btmp` (`lastb`) | xuddi shu | binary |
| Audit | `/var/log/audit/audit.log` | xuddi shu | auditd, SELinux |

Oqim: ilova stdout/syslog() -> **journald** -> (ForwardToSyslog) -> **rsyslog** -> `/var/log/*` va/yoki markaziy server.
```
logger -p user.err "test xabar"      # syslog'ga yozib sinash
journalctl -t myscript
grep -i "sudo" /var/log/auth.log | tail
last -x | head ; lastlog
```
Minimal/konteyner image'larda rsyslog bo'lmasligi mumkin — faqat `journalctl`.

32046.a:
```
# client: /etc/rsyslog.d/90-forward.conf
*.* action(type="omfwd" target="10.0.0.50" port="514" protocol="tcp"
           queue.type="LinkedList" queue.filename="fwd" queue.saveOnShutdown="on"
           action.resumeRetryCount="-1")
# server: /etc/rsyslog.d/10-recv.conf
module(load="imtcp")
input(type="imtcp" port="514")
$template PerHost,"/var/log/remote/%HOSTNAME%/%PROGRAMNAME%.log"
*.* ?PerHost
```
```
rsyslogd -N1                 # config tekshiruvi
systemctl restart rsyslog
```
Senior nuqtalar:
- UDP 514 — yo'qotish mumkin; TCP + disk queue (server o'chiq bo'lsa ham yo'qolmaydi); TLS (`gtls`) tarmoqda shifrlash.
- Structured log (JSON) + `trace_id` — qidirish va korrelyatsiya.
- Hajm/narx: retention siyosati, debug loglarni prod'da o'chirish, sampling; PII/secret loglarga tushmasin.

32047.a:
1. **Patch:** `apt update && apt full-upgrade`; `unattended-upgrades` (faqat security) / `dnf-automatic`.
2. **Userlar:** shaxsiy user'lar + `sudo` guruhi, umumiy parol yo'q; servis user'lari `nologin`; `passwd -l root`.
3. **SSH:** `PermitRootLogin no`, `PasswordAuthentication no`, `AllowGroups`.
4. **Tarmoq:** `ufw default deny incoming`, faqat kerakli portlar; `ss -tulpn` — kutilmagan listener yo'qmi.
5. **Servislar:** `systemctl list-unit-files --state=enabled` — keraksizini `disable --now` (cups, avahi, rpcbind...).
6. **Kernel/sysctl:** `net.ipv4.conf.all.rp_filter=1`, `accept_redirects=0`, `kernel.kptr_restrict=2`, `fs.protected_symlinks=1`, `kernel.unprivileged_bpf_disabled=1`.
7. **FS:** `/tmp` `noexec,nosuid,nodev`; SUID fayllar ro'yxati (`find / -perm -4000 -xdev`).
8. **MAC:** SELinux enforcing / AppArmor profillar.
9. **Audit va log:** auditd, loglar markaziy serverga, `chrony`.
10. **Tekshirish:** `lynis audit system`, OpenSCAP / CIS benchmark; natija IaC (Ansible) ga yoziladi — qo'lda emas.

Prinsip: defense in depth + least privilege + hamma narsa kod sifatida, takrorlanadigan.

32048.a:
```
sudo auditctl -w /etc/passwd -p wa -k identity      # w=write a=attribute
sudo auditctl -w /etc/sudoers -p wa -k sudoers
sudo auditctl -a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S execve -F euid=0 -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=-1 -k rootcmd
sudo auditctl -l                                    # joriy qoidalar
# doimiy: /etc/audit/rules.d/hardening.rules  ->  sudo augenrules --load

sudo ausearch -k identity -i --start today          # -i: uid'larni nomga aylantir
sudo aureport -au                                   # autentifikatsiyalar
sudo aureport -x --summary                          # bajarilgan dasturlar
```
- **auid** (audit uid / loginuid) — `sudo su -` qilinsa ham dastlab kim kirgani saqlanadi. Shuning uchun "root qildi" emas, "mansur root orqali qildi".
- sudo o'zi ham loglaydi: `/var/log/auth.log`, `journalctl _COMM=sudo`; to'liq sessiya: `Defaults log_output` (sudoreplay).
- Ehtiyot: `execve` hamma uchun = juda ko'p log, CPU. Qoidalarni aniq yoz. Audit loglarini markaziy serverga yubor (buzg'unchi o'chirmasin).

32049.a:
```
nmap -Pn -p- --min-rate 1000 203.0.113.10     # hamma 65535 TCP port
nmap -Pn -sV -p 22,80,443,5432,6379 host      # servis + versiya
sudo nmap -sS host                            # SYN (half-open) skan, root kerak
sudo nmap -sU -p 53,123,161 host              # UDP (sekin)
nmap --script ssl-enum-ciphers -p 443 host    # TLS versiya/cipher'lar
nmap -sn 10.0.1.0/24                          # tirik hostlar (ping sweep)
```
Natija holatlari: `open`, `closed` (RST — host bor, port yopiq), `filtered` (javob yo'q — firewall DROP).
Ichkaridan ko'rinish (`ss -tulpn`) va tashqaridan ko'rinish (`nmap`) farqli bo'lishi normal — farq firewall/SG ishlayotganini ko'rsatadi. Klassik topilma: internetga ochiq Redis/Elasticsearch/Docker API (2375), MongoDB.
**Ogohlantirish:** ruxsatsiz begona tizimni skanerlash ko'p mamlakatlarda qonunbuzarlik; cloud provider'lar ham o'z qoidalariga ega.

32050.a:
```
sudo apt install sysstat ; sudo systemctl enable --now sysstat   # ENABLED="true" (/etc/default/sysstat)
sar -u 1 5                           # CPU real vaqt
sar -q                               # run queue, load
sar -r                               # RAM; -S swap; -W swapping (pswpin/s)
sar -d -p                            # disk (await, %util)
sar -n DEV                           # tarmoq interfeyslari; -n EDEV xatolar; -n TCP,ETCP
# kechagi kun 02:30-03:30:
sar -u -f /var/log/sysstat/sa01 -s 02:30:00 -e 03:30:00     # RHEL: /var/log/sa/sa01
sar -A -f /var/log/sysstat/sa01 > report.txt
```
Tahlil yondashuvi: o'sha oraliqda qaysi resurs o'zgardi (CPU `%iowait`, `kbmemused`, `pswpin`, `await`), keyin `journalctl --since/--until` va cron/timer'lar (`systemctl list-timers`, backup, logrotate 03:00?) bilan solishtir. Prod'da asosiy manba — Prometheus/node_exporter grafiklari; sar — zaxira va monitoring yo'q joyda qutqaruvchi.

32051.a:
```
cat /proc/pressure/cpu
# some avg10=35.20 avg60=20.11 avg300=8.03 total=...
cat /proc/pressure/memory
# some avg10=4.00 ...  full avg10=1.50 ...
cat /proc/pressure/io
cat /sys/fs/cgroup/system.slice/app.service/memory.pressure    # bitta servis
```
O'qish:
- `cpu some avg10=35` — so'nggi 10s'da vaqtning 35% ida kamida bitta vazifa CPU kutgan.
- `memory full > 0` — hamma vazifalar xotira (reclaim/swap) kutib turgan — jiddiy, thrashing boshlanishi.
- `io full` yuqori — disk butun tizimni to'xtatmoqda.

Ishlatilishi: systemd-oomd va Android/Facebook oomd PSI asosida OOM'dan **oldin** chora ko'radi; K8s/kubelet eviction; Prometheus `node_pressure_*` metrikalari bilan alert ("memory full > 5% 5 daqiqa").
Load average 8 — 64 core'da hech narsa emas, 2 core'da falokat; PSI 30% — har ikkalasida ham bir xil ma'noda.

32052.a:
```
sudo perf top                                   # tizim bo'yicha issiq funksiyalar
sudo perf top -p PID
sudo perf stat -p PID -- sleep 10               # cycles, instructions, IPC, cache-misses, context-switches
sudo perf record -F 99 -g -p PID -- sleep 30    # 99 Hz, call graph
sudo perf report --stdio | head -50
# flame graph (github.com/brendangregg/FlameGraph)
sudo perf script | ./stackcollapse-perf.pl | ./flamegraph.pl > cpu.svg
```
- `-F 99` — 100 emas, boshqa davriy ishlar bilan "lockstep" bo'lmasligi uchun.
- Symbol yo'q (`[unknown]`, hex manzillar) — debug symbol'lar kerak; JIT tillar (Java/Node) uchun perf-map agent; Go binary'lari perf bilan yaxshi ishlaydi, lekin Go'da pprof qulayroq.
- Konteynerda: host'dan `perf` + `--pid`, yoki `perf_event_paranoid` sozlamasi.
- Off-CPU vaqt (lock, IO kutish) perf top'da ko'rinmaydi — `offcputime` (bcc) yoki bpftrace.
Yengilroq eBPF vositalari: `execsnoop`, `opensnoop`, `biolatency`, `tcpretrans`, `runqlat` (bcc-tools).

32053.a:
**Tayyorgarlik (T-7 kun):**
- Inventarizatsiya: servislar (`systemctl list-units --type=service --state=running`), portlar (`ss -tulpn`), cron/timer'lar, `/etc` o'zgarishlari, sertifikatlar, userlar, firewall, mount'lar, tashqi IP whitelist'lar (partnerlar eski IP'ni ruxsat qilgan bo'lishi mumkin!).
- Yangi server — Ansible/Terraform bilan (qo'lda emas).
- DNS TTL'ni 300 -> 60s ga **oldindan** tushir (eski TTL tugashini kut).

**Ma'lumot:**
```
rsync -aHAXv --numeric-ids old:/srv/ /srv/          # 1-sync (uzoq, servis ishlab turadi)
rsync -aHAXv --numeric-ids --delete old:/srv/ /srv/ # delta (tez)
```
DB: fayl ko'chirish emas — replika qilib ko'tar (streaming replication), cutover'da promote.

**Cutover (bir necha daqiqa):** maintenance / yozishni to'xtat -> oxirgi delta sync / replika lag = 0 -> yangi serverda smoke test -> LB target yoki DNS'ni almashtir -> metrika/log kuzat.
**Rollback:** eski server o'chirilmaydi, trafikni qaytarish 1 buyruq; agar yangi serverda yozishlar bo'lsa — teskari sync rejasi.
**Keyin:** eski serverni 1-2 hafta saqla, keyin o'chir; TTL'ni qaytar; runbook yangilansin.

32054.a:
```
uptime ; last -x reboot | head                 # reboot bo'ldimi, kernel yangilanib qayta yuklandimi
uname -r ; ls -lt /boot | head
grep -E "upgrade|install" /var/log/dpkg.log | tail -30      # Ubuntu
less /var/log/apt/history.log
sudo dnf history ; sudo dnf history info last                # RHEL
find /etc -mmin -1440 -type f -ls 2>/dev/null                # oxirgi 24 soatda o'zgargan config
cd /etc && sudo git log --stat -5                            # etckeeper bo'lsa
journalctl --since yesterday -p warning
systemctl list-units --failed
df -h ; df -i
openssl x509 -enddate -noout -in /etc/ssl/certs/app.pem      # muddati tugadimi
```
Tashqi: CI/CD deploy loglari, Terraform/K8s o'zgarishlari, DNS yozuvlar, cloud provider status sahifasi, partner API.
Sabablarning eng ko'pi: deploy/config o'zgarishi, avtomatik paket yangilanishi, sertifikat yoki parol/token muddati, disk to'lishi, DNS. "Hech narsa o'zgarmagan" deyilsa ham — vaqt o'zgardi (sertifikat, cron, oyning 1-sanasi, ma'lumot hajmi o'sdi).

32055.a:
**1. Tasdiqlash (30s):**
```
df -hT ; df -i
du -xh --max-depth=1 /var 2>/dev/null | sort -h | tail
lsof +L1 | sort -k7 -n | tail          # o'chirilgan, ochiq katta fayllar
```
**2. Mitigation (xavfsiz):**
```
sudo journalctl --vacuum-size=200M
sudo find /var/log -name "*.gz" -mtime +7 -delete
: > /var/log/app/huge.log               # rm emas — truncate (FD ochiq)
: > /proc/PID/fd/N                      # o'chirilgan-lekin-ochiq fayl
docker system prune -f ; sudo apt clean
```
Root uchun 5% rezerv ext4'da tizimni nafas oldiradi; DB fayllarini **qo'lda o'chirma** (Postgres WAL ni o'chirish = DB o'limi; sababini top: replication slot osilgan, archive_command ishlamayapti).
**3. Tiklash:** servis restart/status, ilova xatolari tozalandimi, DB izchilmi.
**4. Root cause:** qaysi katalog o'sdi -> nega (debug log yoqilgan, logrotate ishlamadi, backup lokalda qoldi, osilgan replication slot, tmp fayllar).
**5. Prevention:** logrotate/journald limit, retention, alohida `/var` yoki LV, alert `predict_linear(...[6h], 4*3600) < 0` va inode alert, runbook.

Interview'da baholanadi: tartib (avval stabilizatsiya, dalilni saqlash), xavfli harakatlardan qochish va "takrorlanmasin" qismi.
